leastWorthwhile.text: The final encounter was the least engaging choice because it was the only remaining gameplay option, even though its outcome was clear.

surprise.text: The close pair became more tightly bound while the passing star escaped; I had expected altered orbits but was unsure whether the pair would separate.

continue.text: I would continue: the contrasting outcomes of the encounters made me curious about what happens to the changed pair and the escaping star.
